## Design system (generated by design-system-inventory — do not edit)

Library: @nuxt/ui ^4.12.0. Roots: app/components/ui. Import public components from `app/components/ui/index.ts`.
Tokens in use (CSS custom properties): --font-numeric, --radius-md, --radius-lg, --radius-full, --surface, --surface-raised, --fg, --fg-muted, --border, --focus, --success, --success-fg, --warning, --warning-fg, --danger, --danger-fg, --info, --info-fg.

| Component | Doc | Props (defaults) | Emits | Models | Slots | Variants |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| DsButton (wraps UButton) | yes | tone="primary", size="md", loading=false, disabled=false, type="button" | click | — | icon, default | — |
| DsDataRegion | yes | view, label | — | — | default, empty | — |
| DsDialog (wraps UModal) | yes | title, description, dirty=false | close | open | default, footer | — |
| DsEmptyState | yes | title, help | — | — | default | — |
| DsField | yes | label, hint, error, required | — | — | default | — |
| DsIconButton (wraps UButton) | yes | icon, label, tone="secondary", disabled=false | click | — | — | — |
| DsKpi | yes | label, value, delta | — | — | — | — |
| DsSelect | yes | options, label, placeholder="Select an option", error, required=false | change | modelValue | — | — |
| DsStatusBadge | yes | tone="neutral" | — | — | default | tone: neutral\|info\|success\|warning\|danger |

Rules: import from the barrel, never from a component file; colours, spacing, radii and shadows come from the tokens above, not literals; a data view renders loading, empty, error, partial and success; to go deeper than a wrapper allows, eject the component with the `@ds-ejected` marker and refresh its hash when you edit it.
